title: Launcher: the personal Spotlight step inside the launch (name, line, link saved to the profile, then the Space offer)

source.ref: Owner direction 2026-10-29: someone who only wants a personal Spotlight is taken through that build and offered a Space upsell

detail: The 'Just my personal Spotlight' choice now opens /launch/personal inside the lightbox: a name, one line and a link, filled from the profile, saved back through the one profile writer (updateProfile, no second writer; it blanks fields it is not given, so the call is built from the stored profile and changes only name, bio and website). The real /spotlight/<handle> shows beside the form; after saving, a card offers a Space, and the Space launch fills from the same profile so the words come along. Not in this slice: the photo, the products shelf, and a Finish setup 'Personal' group for people with no Space (no launch row exists for a personal-only path yet).

verify.evidence: The step page, the save action and the pure builder exist and the step saves only through updateProfile.
